title: Ann Arbor, MI — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Ann Arbor, MI: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Ann Arbor is a city in MI with a population of 121,536. College town with University of Michigan, Big Ten sports, and intellectual energy. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 27.7.
